name: Package for Thurman
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
My son Thurman is an apprentice at the Larson Clothiers, in the Mage's Quarter.  He was in a hurry today and forgot his shears and needles.  I know a great Champion like you must have important tasks at hand, but without his tools Thurman can't do his apprentice work!

Please, adventurer.  Can you take my son's sewing kit to him?  Larson Clothiers is one of two clothing shops in the Mage's Quarter - it's the one deeper in, near the Mage's Tower.
narrative.objectives: Go to the Larson Clothiers in the Stormwind Mage Quarter, and give Thurman Schneider his Sewing Kit.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Oh, blast! I thought forgetting my kit would free me from work. Now I guess I'll have to help the Larsons with their sewing...

Oh, well. Fun will come later I guess.
narrative.requestItemsText: Are you here to buy clothes?
